objective_is_complete_only_when: Every official bullet and nested bullet for the objective is assigned to at least one PRIM3 instructional module.
The assigned module teaches the concept in conventional reading or guided practice rather than merely naming it.
The learner is required to demonstrate the concept through an assessment question, lab task, or both.
The coverage is traceable back to the official CompTIA objective identifier.
A song reference may reinforce the concept but never substitutes for required instruction.
completion_contract.course_complete_only_when: All 28 Security Plus objectives and all 25 Network Plus objectives satisfy the completion rule across the fixed 63 module course.

authoring_rule: Every new song unit must reduce the remaining uncovered CompTIA objective inventory. The fixed course remains exactly 63 modules. Dense certification material is distributed across the existing modules instead of creating additional modules.
